yaml:
scenario: Tumor_Lysis_Syndrome_Detection
version: 1.0.0
description: Detect laboratory tumor lysis syndrome based on Cairo-Bishop classification
signals:
  UricAcid:
    ref: uric_acid
    expected_unit: mg/dL
    description: Serum uric acid level
    concept_id: 43532213
    concept_code: '1427088'
    vocabulary_id: RxNorm
  Potassium:
    ref: potassium
    expected_unit: mEq/L
    description: Serum potassium level
    concept_id: 19049024
    concept_code: '8588'
    vocabulary_id: RxNorm
  Phosphate:
    ref: phosphate
    expected_unit: mg/dL
    description: Serum phosphate level
    concept_id: 19112944
    concept_code: '486961'
    vocabulary_id: RxNorm
  Calcium:
    ref: calcium
    expected_unit: mg/dL
    description: Serum calcium level
    concept_id: 19018544
    concept_code: '1895'
    vocabulary_id: RxNorm
trends:
  uric_acid_current:
    expr: last(UricAcid)
    description: Current uric acid level
  potassium_current:
    expr: last(Potassium)
    description: Current potassium level
  phosphate_current:
    expr: last(Phosphate)
    description: Current phosphate level
  calcium_current:
    expr: last(Calcium)
    description: Current calcium level
logic:
  hyperuricemia:
    when: uric_acid_current >= 8.0
    severity: low
    description: Uric acid level 8 mg/dL or higher
  hyperkalemia:
    when: potassium_current >= 6.0
    severity: low
    description: Potassium level 6.0 mEq/L or higher
  hyperphosphatemia:
    when: phosphate_current >= 4.5
    severity: low
    description: Phosphate level 4.5 mg/dL or higher
  hypocalcemia:
    when: calcium_current <= 7.0
    severity: low
    description: Calcium level 7.0 mg/dL or lower
  tls_flag:
    when: (hyperuricemia + hyperkalemia + hyperphosphatemia + hypocalcemia) >= 2
    severity: high
    description: Laboratory tumor lysis syndrome detected with two or more abnormalities
outputs:
  decision:
    has_tls:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.tls_flag
      description: Patient has laboratory tumor lysis syndrome
  features:
    uric_acid_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.uric_acid_current
      description: Current uric acid level
    potassium_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.potassium_current
      description: Current potassium level
    phosphate_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.phosphate_current
      description: Current phosphate level
    calcium_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.calcium_current
      description: Current calcium level
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: When this evaluation was performed
